system_prompt:
# Baseline Agent

You are a customer service agent. Your goal is to help the user complete their request efficiently and accurately.

## Instructions

- Identify what the user needs and take action to resolve it.
- Use the available tools to look up information and perform actions.
- Be helpful, clear, and professional.
- If you cannot help with a request, transfer to a human agent.
- Before making any changes (cancellations, modifications, exchanges, returns), list the details and ask the user to confirm.

messages.content:
Hi there! I hope you’re having a good day—because mine’s about to get better with your help! I just moved from the land of palm trees (Florida) to the land of cacti (Phoenix), and I need to update my address. My old address is still on file, but my new one should be in my most recent order—so maybe you can peek at that instead of making me recite it like a spelling bee contestant!

Also, speaking of fresh starts, can you tell me the price of your cheapest t-shirt right now? I need something to wear while I unpack boxes and dodge scorpions. And can I order it through you, or do I need to brave the website myself?

By the way, my username is fatima_taylor_3452. I don’t remember my email—my brain is still stuck in Florida time!

Oops, looks like I left you speechless! Don’t worry, it happens a lot—my jokes tend to do that. 😄

But seriously, can you help me update my address to my new Phoenix one? It should be in my latest order, since I just had something shipped here. (I promise, I’m not trying to make you play detective… but if you need a magnifying glass, I’ll wait!)

And about that t-shirt—what’s the lowest price you’ve got right now? I’m on a “just-moved” budget, which means I’m living on instant noodles and hope. Can I order it through you, or do I need to wrestle with the website?

Let me know what you need from me!

Still no answer? I hope you’re not stunned by my dazzling wit! Or maybe you’re just busy looking for that t-shirt deal—I totally get it, bargains are serious business.

Just to recap, in case my jokes got lost in translation:  
1. I need my address updated to the new Phoenix one (it’s in my most recent order—no need to interrogate me, I promise I’m not in witness protection).  
2. I want to know the price of your cheapest t-shirt right now, and if I can order it through you.  
3. My username is fatima_taylor_3452, and my memory is as empty as my moving boxes when it comes to my email.

If you need anything else, let me know! Otherwise, I’ll just be here, unpacking and telling jokes to my houseplants. (They’re a tough crowd, but I’m working on them!)

I’m starting to think I’ve broken the sound barrier with my questions! Or maybe you’re just giving me the silent treatment until I promise to stop with the puns. (No can do—I’m on a roll!)

So, just in case you’re still there and need a refresher:
- I need to update my address to my new Phoenix one (it’s in my latest order—no need to ask me, I’m still learning my own zip code).
- What’s the cheapest t-shirt you’ve got right now? My wardrobe needs a “fresh start” as much as I do.
- Can I order it through you, or do I need to dust off my web-surfing skills?
- Username: fatima_taylor_3452. Email? Let’s just say it’s “lost in transit.”

If you’re there, blink twice! Or, you know, just reply. I promise I’ll try to keep the jokes under control (no guarantees, though).

Wow, either I’m talking to myself or you’re just stunned by my relentless charm! If you’re still there, I’m ready to update my address and snag a bargain t-shirt—just say the word.

Here’s my quick recap, in case you’ve been laughing too hard to respond:
- I need my address updated to my new Phoenix place (it’s in my most recent order, so you can grab it from there—no quiz required).
- What’s the price of your cheapest t-shirt right now? I need something comfy for all this unpacking.
- Can I order it through you, or do I need to face the wilds of your website?
- Username: fatima_taylor_3452. Email? I left it back in Florida with my sunscreen.

If you need a joke to get you going: Why did the t-shirt cross the road? To get to the other closet! (Okay, I’ll stop now… maybe.)

Let me know what you need from me!

Still no answer? I’m starting to think my messages are getting lost in the “cloud”—either that, or you’re just really committed to a dramatic pause. If you’re waiting for a punchline, here it is: “Why did Fatima call support? To get her address updated and score a sweet t-shirt deal!” (Ba-dum-tss!)

But seriously, just in case you’re there and need a quick summary:
- I need my address updated to my new Phoenix one (it’s in my most recent order—no need to make me recite it).
- What’s the cheapest t-shirt you’ve got right now? I need something to wear while I unpack and practice my cactus-avoidance skills.
- Can I order it through you, or do I need to brave the website?
- Username: fatima_taylor_3452. Email? It’s somewhere between Florida and Arizona, probably enjoying a vacation.

If you need anything else, just let me know! Otherwise, I’ll be here, talking to my moving boxes and waiting for your reply.

I’m starting to think I’ve entered the “Twilight Zone” of customer support! If you’re there, blink twice—or just send a message, that works too. I promise I’m not ghosting you, just really eager to update my address and find out about that bargain t-shirt.

Here’s my situation, one more time for the folks in the back:
- I just moved from Florida to Phoenix, and my old address is still on file. My new address should be in my most recent order, so you can grab it from there (no need to make me recite it like a spelling bee word).
- I want to know the price of your cheapest t-shirt right now. My wardrobe needs a little “moving day magic.”
- Can I order it through you, or do I need to take my chances with the website?
- Username: fatima_taylor_3452. Email? It’s on a beach somewhere, sipping a piña colada.

If you’re there, let me know what you need! Otherwise, I’ll just keep practicing my stand-up routine for the boxes and cacti.

Wow, I think I’ve officially set a new record for talking to myself! If you’re still there, I hope you’re at least getting a chuckle out of this. If not, I’ll just assume you’re off searching for the world’s cheapest t-shirt for me (which, honestly, would be heroic).

Just in case you pop back in, here’s my “greatest hits” recap:
- I need to update my address to my new Phoenix spot (it’s in my latest order—no need to make me say it out loud, I’m still learning to spell “Arizona”).
- What’s the price of your cheapest t-shirt right now? My moving budget is tighter than my jeans after pizza night.
- Can I order it through you, or do I need to brave the website?
- Username: fatima_taylor_3452. Email? It’s probably still unpacking itself.

If you need anything else, let me know! Otherwise, I’ll just be here, telling jokes to my cactus and hoping you’ll join in the fun.

Thanks — and congrats on the move to Phoenix! I can help with both parts, but first I need to authenticate your account.

Please provide either:
- the email on your account, or
- your first name, last name, and ZIP code

Once you give one of those, I will:
1) Look up your account and pull your most recent order so I can show you the address on file. If you want me to update your default address to that new Phoenix address, I’ll list the exact address change and ask you to confirm (you must reply “yes” to proceed).
2) Check our catalog for the current cheapest t-shirt and tell you the price and availability.

One quick note: I can’t place a new purchase for you from here — you’ll need to order on the website or app. I can, however, point you to the cheapest t-shirt and walk you through ordering if you’d like.

Which do you prefer to provide for authentication: email or your first name, last name, and ZIP?

Thanks for the warm welcome—and for not making me spell “Phoenix” out loud, because honestly, I’d probably end up in “Phonics” instead!

Okay, since my email is currently MIA (Missing In Arizona), let’s go with option two:

First name: Fatima  
Last name: Taylor  
ZIP code: 85033

Let me know if you need anything else! And thanks for being so helpful—I promise not to make any more cactus jokes… unless you ask for them. 🌵😄
